text: In Chu, King Dao, who had long heard of his ability, made him chief minister. He made the laws clear and strict, cut offices that were not needed, dismissed royal kinsmen of distant blood, and put the state's strength into its army; Chu grew strong, and the other states feared its power. For this reason, the history says, Chu's nobles all wanted him dead. When King Dao died, members of the royal clan rose up and attacked Wu Qi. He ran to the king's body and threw himself on it; his attackers shot and stabbed him, and struck the king's body too. Once the crown prince came to the throne, he had everyone who had struck the king's body put to death, and more than seventy families were wiped out for it.
